definitions.explanation: Something made to look like the genuine article in order to deceive. Can refer to counterfeit goods, forged documents, or a person pretending to be something they are not.

examples.japanese: これは{偽物|にせもの}だ。
{偽物|にせもの}のブランド{品|ひん}を{買|か}ってしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally bought a counterfeit brand-name product.

examples.japanese: {本物|ほんもの}と{偽物|にせもの}の{見分|みわ}けがつかないほど{精巧|せいこう}にできている。
examples.english: It is so well made that you cannot tell the real thing from the fake.

notes:
The opposite of {本物|ほんもの} (the real thing, genuine article). {偽物|にせもの} carries a strongly negative connotation, implying deliberate deception.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{偽物|にせもの}をつかまされる (be passed off a fake)
・{偽物|にせもの}を{見抜|みぬ}く (see through a fake)
・{本物|ほんもの}と{偽物|にせもの} (the real thing and the fake)
